other_conditions: All new micro manufacturing enterprises established anywhere in Tamil Nadu are eligible.
All new small and medium enterprises operating in any of the 24 listed thrust sectors are eligible.
All new small and medium manufacturing enterprises located in any of the 254 industrially backward blocks are eligible.
All new agro‑based small and medium manufacturing enterprises located in any of the 388 blocks are eligible.
Existing manufacturing enterprises of the above categories undertaking substantial expansion or diversification are eligible.
Enterprises set up by women, scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, differently‑abled and transgender entrepreneurs are eligible for an additional 5% subsidy.
The application must be submitted within one year from the commencement of commercial production.
benefits_summary: 25% capital subsidy on eligible plant and machinery up to ₹1.5 crore, plus additional subsidies of up to ₹5 lakhs for women, SC, ST, differently‑abled and transgender entrepreneurs and up to ₹5 lakhs for micro‑enterprises.
